title: Display "over the top" High values
symptom: The user reports that during a high BG episode, the app does not display plot values above 400 mg/dl, even though raw values are available and seem usable. They want visibility of the trend above 400 to take actions.
cause: The thread suggests that the hardcoded limit of 400 in the code is because Dexcom devices switch to displaying 'HIGH' above 400 and do not provide a higher glucose value. The user is using a Libre, and it is unclear what its hardcoded max is.
evidence_quote: It's probably hardcoded there because dexcom devices will above 400 switch to displaying "HIGH" and don't display a higher glucose value. Looks like you're using a Libre, not a G4/G5, and I'm not sure what their hardcoded max value is.
